name: EMELIA
description: Experience the perfect balance of comfort and style in the Emelia, our most popular model that has captured the hearts of countless families. Spanning 2,060 square feet with 3 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, this home feels remarkably spacious yet incredibly cozy. The generous living areas flow seamlessly, enhanced by vaulted ceilings that amplify natural light throughout. Every detail has been carefully curated, from the custom cabinets and granite countertops to the energy-efficient appliances. With hurricane impact protection built-in and a layout designed for real family living, the Emelia delivers exceptional value in a home you'll be proud to call yours.
